image_description: A surreal, semi-monochrome street scene featuring several people walking on a paved plaza. Dominating the upper half are massive, elongated soap bubbles with vibrant iridescent colors (pinks, greens, blues) that contrast sharply with the desaturated background. The largest bubble stretches horizontally across the frame, appearing to float above the pedestrians. A smaller spherical bubble is visible on the right. An orange object lies on the ground in the foreground.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The main bubble is an extremely long, horizontal tube. Physically, such a thin film would likely sag significantly due to gravity or burst. It maintains a rigid, impossible geometry without visible support or realistic sagging.
The vertical lines of the building in the background show slight warping. The pedestrians have slightly unnatural proportions and blending with the ground, typical of AI-generated figures.
The paving stones lack consistent geometric perspective and texture detail becomes muddy in the distance.
